results.title: Oat Milk
results.overview: A grieving woman finds a lost message from her late boyfriend and quietly confronts the space between love, regret, and letting go.

results.title: Hasip and Nasip
results.overview: In a town named "Hasımlar", the mayoralty has alternated between Hasip and Nasip for years. But when their childhood sweetheart Perihan returns to town and a third candidate emerges, the established order between the two old friends is disrupted. Both Hasip and Nasip, wanting to win the mayoralty and Perihan's heart, throw the town into turmoil with their increasingly malicious election promises and traps.

results.title: Simon
results.overview: After a drug-fueled night in Budapest, a young man drifts through a sunny city hollowed out by politically captured institutions before retreating into a spiral of isolation, addiction, and compulsive desire.

results.title: Anam
results.overview: As Fionn patiently awaits his inevitable end on a lonely island, an innocent voice disrupts his peace and leads him back to the beginning. An Irish animated  short film

results.title: Wildman
results.overview: An aloof young man escapes to the wilds of Yosemite in the throes of a depressive episode. His only companion is a camera.

results.title: Bewildered
results.overview: Set in 1977, "Bewildered" follows Terry Perkins, a young, small-town girl who enters a hit game show for the chance to win $5,000 in hopes of saving her sick father, only to discover the charismatic host leads a cannibalistic cult!

results.title: NJPW New Japan Cup 2026 - Day 6
results.overview: The sixth night of New Japan Cup 2026 took place on March 12, 2026, at Takamatsu City Gymnasium in Takamatsu, Kagawa, Japan and featured two second-round matches.

results.title: Disconnected
results.overview: When a digital pandemic hits the Czech city of Olomouc, spreading through a mobile app that controls the human mind, the paths of a cynical taxi driver and a hunted scientist collide as they fight for survival.

results.title: Mi casa no es tu casa
results.original_title: Mi casa no es tu casa

results.title: God of Frogs
results.overview: An Anthology film about four segments surrounding the same monster. Deep in the heart of the jungle exists an elemental creature with an eternal hunger, and every 25 years, it emerges: a woman is eaten alive in 1969, a film crew goes missing in 1994, a politician explodes live on television in 2019, and a multinational corporation goes up in flames in 2044.

results.title: Baby Girl
results.overview: On a Christmas night, a guilt-ridden hospital attendant and a determined rookie cop race against time to recover a kidnapped newborn, unaware that the woman who took the baby is fighting a heartbreaking battle to finally call a child her own.

results.title: JINX
results.overview: After moving into her new home, Mia, a mute Girl, discovers a cursed dollhouse hidden in the attic. When her younger brother vanishes into thin air, she must unlock the relic's dark mysteries before the ancient hex claims his soul forever.

results.title: The Dating App Nightmare
results.overview: Single mom Kate signs up for a dating app with her daughter Sarah, turning it into a fun bonding moment. But the fun ends fast when Sarah goes missing after a date with someone she met on the app. With little help, Kate launches her own search.

results.title: The Last Hail Mary
results.overview: When the planet Mercury is swallowed up by the Sun’s gravitational pull, a team aboard the Interplanetary Space Station, including a suspicious Martian scientist, must race to reverse the effect before Venus, and even Earth, are destroyed forever.

results.title: Patakka Guddiyan
results.overview: Roohi, a simple girl, is the complete opposite of her twin sister Mahi, who is sharp, daring, and mischievous. As the story progresses, layers of suspense and drama unfold.

results.title: NJPW Sakura Genesis 2026
results.overview: Sakura Genesis 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on April 4, 2026 at Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan. The show was headlined by an IWGP Heavyweight Championship match between Yota Tsuji and the winner of the 2026 New Japan Cup tournament, Callum Newman.

results.title: AAA Verano de Escándalo 2026 - Week 1
results.overview: AAA Verano de Escándalo Week 1 goes LIVE from Aguascalientes with AAA General Manager Rey Mysterio! Plus, the AAA World Mixed Tag Team Championship is on the line as Lola Vice and Mr. Iguana take on La Hiedra and Laredo Kid. In the main event, Dominik Mysterio and El Grande Americano collide with Los Perros del Mal.

results.title: Scorpion
results.overview: Amidst the rise of saffronisation among Indian youth, Saleel, a queer content creator works for the extremist Vinchu Sena party. When tasked with a destructive mission against an author, a mistaken target leads Saleel to confront his identity and society’s divisions.

results.title: Maralinga Maningrida Mantamaru
results.overview: A neverending noon. A loop of secrets. Miranda, Marion, Sarah, Irma, and Joan. Stuck in time and time travelers. They may be the only living people left on Earth. Testimonies, songs, and traumas from Australia.
